cohort: Mothers who delivered at the Clinic of Obstetrics and Gynecology of the University Clinical Centre Sarajevo between October 2013 and February 2014.
finding: Preterm deliveries were significantly associated with rupture of fetal membranes, Cesarean section, severely depressed one-minute Apgar score (0-3), and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with preterm delivery.
